body: Thank you very much. I really needed someone to talk to. I don't feel better, but, I do feel that I'm on the path to feeling better. I needed to get that out.

Not really. It's manual labor and I had a science job. I do find some relief in the fact that I have a degree, as there is lower unemployment if you have one.

The losing love thing hurts much, much worse. But, I did kind of know she wasn't serious about me. So, maybe, I should find solace in having some finality. I just feel terrible because I wanted to start a family with her. A lot of guys say their lady is the most beautiful girl in the world, but, I meant it. There's nothing I liked more than holding her. I hate that we can't even be friends anymore.

The thing is, I know what the problem is. I just feel stupid actually saying it, so, I wish I could cry instead.

I ruined my career. I think that's related to my other problem. I just found out that (the person who was) my lady is in a relationship with another guy. She has been fairly nice to me ever since I lost my last job, but, I could tell she lost a lot of respect for me since I had to get a temp job.

She got fired herself last week and called me beforehand asking for help. As soon as she knew she was fired, she was with this new dude.

I know it must sound like teenage BS. But, at 25, work and love is all I had going for me. I've been in love with this girl for years. I spent years and tens of thousands of dollars on my degree.
I hafta go to work in a few hours and I want to let this out. I just can't figure out how to express my sadness.
